description: Creates the agent from a proposal, at the quoted monthly price, owned by this key's email. Call it only after your human has seen what it will follow, its searches and its price, and said yes. Returns the agent and its page on sense.quorumz.com. During the private test only invited accounts can create one; a proposal's can_create says whether this key can. Needs the Quorumz API key on this connection.

handle.description: Its address. Optional: one is suggested from the places and topics.
handle.title: Handle

name.description: A name for the agent. Optional.
name.title: Name

price_usd_month.description: quote.price_usd_month of the proposal, exactly as your human saw it. If the price changed since, nothing is created and the new price is returned.
price_usd_month.title: Price Usd Month

proposal_id.description: The id of a proposal from propose_search_agent.
proposal_id.title: Proposal Id

setup_item_ids.description: Ids from setup_items your human wants done (for example finding a person's accounts). Optional.
setup_item_ids.title: Setup Item Ids

name: create_search_agent
title: Create a research agent
